content.value: The 25 KVA transformer has 500 turns on the primary and 50 turns on the secondary. (12) The primary is connected to 3000 V, 50 Hz supply. Find the full-load primary and secondary currents, the secondary E.M.F and the maximum flux in the core. Neglect leakage drops and no-load primary current.
